svg.text: IOD Quadrant Layout — NPS1 vs NPS4 NUMA Mapping
Supermicro AS-8126GS-TNMR · 2x AMD EPYC 9575F · 1 IOD per socket, 4 quadrants each
2 NUMA nodes · 4 GPUs per node · matchAttribute: numaNode groups 4 GPUs together
Coarsest granularity. GPU+NIC always co-located, but scheduler can't distinguish quadrants.
8 NUMA nodes · 2 GPUs per node (4 GPU nodes + 4 infra nodes) · matches IOD quadrant
Finer granularity. matchAttribute: numaNode now means 'same IOD quadrant' — natural 2-GPU scheduling unit.
NUMA 0: Q0(2 GPU) + Q1(infra) + Q2(infra) + Q3(2 GPU) = 4 GPUs
NUMA 1: Q0(2 GPU) + Q1(infra) + Q2(infra) + Q3(2 GPU) = 4 GPUs
